_comment: GoodBehaviorBiz managed-settings template — owner-enforced guard, locked so no project or session can shed it. NOT installed by scripts/install.js (it writes only under a target project's own .claude/); this file is deployed BY AN ADMIN to a fixed, machine-wide OS path outside any project. See templates/OWNER-SETUP.md for the full walkthrough — deploy the hook files to a fixed location first (the 'command' paths below assume /usr/local/share/goodbehavior/hooks/, adjust to your actual deployment path), then install this file, then restart Claude Code sessions.
